author: btaylor
text: Every major internet company and every entrepreneur I know supports #NetNeutrality. The FCC should not ignore the voice of the employees the industry that has created millions of jobs over the past decade. A free internet is the best thing for our country and for our economy.

author: btaylor
text: The current version of the Senate Tax Bill is a disaster for startups because it taxes options upon vesting. Startup stock is illiquid and options often not exercised. This “reform” is nonsensical and benefits incumbents over small businesses — opposite of encouraging innovation.

author: btaylor
text: It started as a ❤️ symbol, but then FriendFeed employee Ana said she would quit if she had to look at pages of ❤️s all day (she was grumpy like that). So we launched with 😀, and Facebook eventually adopted the feature with the now ubiquitous 👍.
